3004: pub open spec fn page_organization_pages_match_data(
3005:     page_data: PageData,
3006:     pla: PageLocalAccess,
3007:     psa: PageSharedAccess,
3008:     page_id: PageId,
3009:     popped: Popped) -> bool
3010: {
3011:     psa.points_to.is_init() && (
3012:     match (*pla.count.value(), *pla.inner.value(), *pla.prev.value(), *pla.next.value()) {
3013:         (count, inner, prev, next) => {
3014:             &&& (match page_data.count {
3015:                 None => true,
3016:                 Some(c) => count as int == c
3017:             })
3018:             &&& (match page_data.full {
3019:                 None => true,
3020:                 Some(b) => inner.in_full() == b,
3021:             })
3022:             &&& (match page_data.offset {
3023:                 None => true,
3024:                 Some(o) => psa.points_to.value().offset as int ==
3025:                             o * SIZEOF_PAGE_HEADER
3026:             })
3027:             &&& (match page_data.dlist_entry {
3028:                 None => true,
3029:                 Some(page_queue_data) => {
3030:                     &&& is_page_ptr_opt(prev, page_queue_data.prev)
3031:                     &&& is_page_ptr_opt(next, page_queue_data.next)
3032:                 }
3033:             })
3034:             &&& (match page_data.page_header_kind {
3035:                 None => {
3036:                     (page_id.idx == 0 ==> {
3037:                       &&& !page_data.is_used
3038:                       &&& (match popped {
3039:                           Popped::SegmentCreating(sid) if sid == page_id.segment_id =>
3040:                               true,
3041:                           _ => inner.xblock_size != 0
3042:                       })
3043:                       &&& (!popped.is_SegmentCreating() ==> inner.xblock_size != 0)
3044:                     })
3045:                     && (page_id.idx != 0 ==> page_data.offset == Some(0nat) ==> (
3046:                         (!(popped.is_Ready() && popped.get_Ready_0() == page_id) &&
3047:                             !(popped.is_VeryUnready() && popped.get_VeryUnready_0() == page_id.segment_id && popped.get_VeryUnready_1() == page_id.idx))
3048:                           ==>
3049:                         (page_data.is_used <==> inner.xblock_size != 0)
3050:                     ))
3051:                 }
3052:                 Some(PageHeaderKind::Normal(_, bsize)) => {
3053:                     &&& page_id.idx != 0
3054:                     &&& page_data.is_used
3055:                     &&& inner.xblock_size != 0
3056:                     &&& inner.xblock_size == bsize
3057:                     &&& page_data.is_used
3058:                     &&& page_data.offset == Some(0nat)
3059:                 }
3060:             })
3061:         }
3062:     })
3063: }

3070:     && (forall |segment_id: SegmentId| segments.dom().contains(segment_id) ==>
